title: Asymptotic error in majority Fourier weight
statement: As odd integers $k$ tend to infinity, the error between the limiting majority Fourier weight and $(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-3/2}$ is $O\bigl((2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-5/2}\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ ranges over odd natural numbers tending to infinity
